TCD.Settings.ModuleEnabled.Name: Enable Tricky Critical Dice
TCD.Settings.ModuleEnabled.Hint: Master switch for this world. When off, critical hits roll and total exactly as dnd5e normally would.
TCD.Settings.DiceCount.Name: Dice Maximized Per Critical
TCD.Settings.DiceCount.Hint: How many dice are maximized on each critical hit. This is the total across the whole crit, not per damage part - a Rogue's weapon dice and Sneak Attack dice compete for the same slots. Default 2.
TCD.Settings.ApplyToNPCs.Name: Apply to NPCs
TCD.Settings.ApplyToNPCs.Hint: When on (default), every critical hit is upgraded, including monsters'. When off, only player-owned characters benefit.
